verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect documents a disputes capability: platforms can view disputes filed against both the platform and its connected accounts in the Dashboard, which supports the idea that chargebacks are tracked per sub-merchant. The rest of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: confirmation that chargebacks are attributed or debited to the correct connected account, documented evidence submission via API and Dashboard, automatic reconciliation of dispute outcomes into seller balances, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, disputes are managed per seller — chargebacks land against the right sub-merchant, evidence is submitted via API or dashboard, and outcomes flow back into seller balances automatically

citations.quote: You can view all disputes filed against your platform and connected accounts in your Dashboard.
